title: 可搬式段差スロープ
description: 滑り止めリブ、黄色い端部表示、背面グリップ、固定ポイントを備えるゴム製段差スロープ。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A rubber curb transition wedge with raised traction ribs, bright edge markers, carrying recess and rear fixing points. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
